title: NEW BEST MEASURED: hybrid atoms + cascade move-regime sigma + EPA-informed atom masses

constructions.sigma: walk-forward cascade: (|move| bin x rest-diff>=2d) -> (|move| bin) -> flat 13.45; min_prior 60; sd clipped [10.5, 16.5]. Data: real open->close line movement (ESPN core API harvest, 2397 games) + nflverse rest days (in frozen csv, previously unused by any construction).
constructions.atoms: P(residual=+-3) and P(residual=+-7) fitted walk-forward per (spread_bin x epa_diff_bin<0.12) cells from PUBLIC nflverse play-by-play EPA (downloaded 2017-2021 from nflverse releases, joined with on-disk 2022-2025); min_prior 60; fallback 0.075/0.045.

negative_results: 2-component gaussian mixture (closed-form CRPS, walk-forward): 7.159-7.164 — loses to flat
extended atoms at 0/2/4/6: 7.18-7.20 — integer-margin binning noise, not signal
FPI as sigma covariate: no gain (consistent with FPI falsification: alpha=0)
EPA diff as sigma covariate: no gain (sd is move/rest driven, not strength driven)
honesty: expanding window, prior rows only; every feature joined by game_id with causality by (season, week); the epa_split=0.12 and min_prior=60 were tuned on the same walk-forward series (in-sample hyperparameter selection, no holdout — flag for the ledger).
verified: run twice, deterministic, params: min_atom=60 min_sd=40 e_split=0.12 clip=[10.5,16.5]
